title: Research: exact UT5(Z) four-role minimum is five
body:
## Result

This is a scoped exact negative result, not a new kappa. In `F2[UT5(Z)]` on four arbitrary dirty scalar roles, the fixed target `diag([g1*g2],[g2],[g3],[g4])` has exact minimum paid length five for the eight signed simple-root labels and all 120 binary rank-one idempotents.

The direct five-factor word replays exactly. The first-superdiagonal character forces every realization to have odd length; one factor cannot support the four distinct nonidentity target addresses. An exact full-formal-algebra meet-in-the-middle covers all `960^3 = 884,736,000` ordered three-factor words and finds zero matches. It checks all 960 right-query formulas against direct matrix multiplication and records deterministic transcript hashes. The work does not establish a supplier transfer or affect the selected frontier.

## Reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut5-four-role-mixed-root-seede2a8
```

Local evidence: `verify.py` and `scripts/research_package.py --check-only` pass under Python 3.14.7; this host has no Python 3.12 interpreter, so I did not claim a local registered Python 3.12 replay. The package uses only the standard library.

## Scope and overlap

The nearest completed count match is the finite `F2[D8]` result in Discussion #1773 / `research/d8-mixed-target-seeda97c8e`: that endpoint has three nonidentity roles, one identity role, and two involutory labels. This package pins and distinguishes it. Here the address group is infinite and torsion-free `UT5(Z)`, every role has a nonidentity target, and each signed root difference has rational rank one. Recent active UT5(F2) and A4 claims were also compared in `TASK.json`; the fresh overlap search found no other exact UT5(Z) height-two claim.
